name: Resona Holdings, Inc.
summary: Resona Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the provision retail and commercial banking products and services in Japan and internationally. The company operates Individual, Corporate, and market segment. It provides consulting services, that includes personal loan, asset management, and asset succession services to individuals; and corporate lending, asset management using trusts, real estate operations, corporate pensions, and business succession services to corporates. The company is also involved in financial market services, that includes short term lending, borrowing, purchase and sale of bonds, and derivatives trading.
